steps.name: pressure-cook
steps.note: The sealed can or box is covered with water and cooked, the shorter time for a light, soft dulce and the longer for a dark, firm one.

processing.text: The milk and sugar can also be simmered down for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirred nearly all the time.

sources.text: The pressure cooker times and cooling from this article, which gives no temperatures.
